advisoryFindings.title: R3 important selection order is implicit
advisoryFindings.improvement: In the R3 test, also assert that the important summary entries are the first 10 important issue-log entries, e.g. gate detail 0 through gate detail 9.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The current test covers summary limits, counts, omissions, and recent non-important selection, so implementation is not blocked; the extra assertion would make the important-entry ordering requirement more explicit.
